title: A brick stable behind 1712 Prairie
items: The alley behind 1712 Prairie now has its two-storey brick stable: 12 m along the alley and 7.6 m deep, with a fire wall on the lot line to the north and a window pair at the middle of its alley wall. Its outline, storeys, brick and window place come from the 1911 Sanborn sheet, and Robinson's 1886 atlas draws the same stable, so it stood through 1904. The doors, loft hatch, other windows and roof come from the shared coach-house kit and are reconstructed.
